fixture_provenance.policy: Generated locally; no private footage or downloaded evaluation corpus.
fixture_provenance.video: Pinned OpenReel FFmpeg generates five visually distinct source takes.
fixture_provenance.speech: Windows SAPI creates the checked-in scripted dialogue and pauses.
fixture_provenance.analysis: Local Whisper plus content-addressed silence analysis provide evidence to every harness.
fixture_provenance.time_base: All editing and scoring use exact integer source or project frames.

machine: real MP4 export, SHA-256, and media probe

human.acceptance: A nullable first-pass accept/reject decision that is never inferred from machine assertions.

tasks.name: finished vertical story
tasks.prompt: Create a finished vertical social cut from the media pool. Use take-A's content first, then take-C, then take-D. Do not use take-B or take-E. Remove every cuttable dead-air span at least 20 source frames long and every recognized filler word while preserving all other spoken content. Keep the selected media gapless. Then use add_styled_captions with the social preset and pop motion. Inspect a 9:16 delivery storyboard, run technical QA, and inspect vertical_short delivery conformance at a centered 50/50 focal point. Do not queue the export; the benchmark will render the exact verified timeline snapshot. Keep working until the inspectors confirm the brief.

budget.cost_policy: No portable USD ceiling: subscription harnesses may expose tokens without an attributable price.
